special_fee_schedules.note: Revised fee slab printed separately on p.9 — CONFLICTS with the main-table Group-B row for BS. Bioinformatics (Rs 95,375 first semester). Both are kept; students must verify with the university office which applies.

special_fee_schedules.applies_to: Underperforming programs (Group-A): BS History, BS Pakistan Studies, BS Archeology, BS Persian, BS Saraiki, BS Iqbal Studies, BS Philosophy, BS Urdu, BS Geography
special_fee_schedules.note: Fee structure 'considered as Underperforming Program', applicable from Fall 2025 (p.9, note iii). Serial No. 8 is missing in the source list. This slab differs from the main table for the same programs — verify with the office.

policies.title: Air-conditioning (AC) charges
policies.text: AC charges: Rs. 2,000/- will be charged from each student, each semester, where air-conditioning (A.C.) facility is available in the classroom. (PDF p.9)

policies.title: Civil Engineering self-finance fee (Fall 2025)
policies.text: The regular semester fee will be charged from new intake instead of double semester fee from Self Finance students of Civil Engineering Department, applicable from Fall 2025. (PDF p.9, note ii)

policies.title: Scope of this fee structure
policies.text: This fee structure applies from Fall Session 2025 onwards and, per the source file name, to new intake only. Continuing students may be on a different structure. Always verify with the official university office.
